北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾霾天，体感 4℃，出门记得戴口罩，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy, feels like 4℃. Remember to wear a mask and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 3℃，风力不小，多穿点，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 3℃ with a brisk wind. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 2℃，湿冷感强。多穿衣，别感冒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 2℃ and damp. Wear more clothes, don't catch a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 19℃，体感舒适。可以外出走走！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, 19℃ and comfortable. Enjoy a walk outside!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 17℃，阳光正好，心情也美美哒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, feels like 17℃. Enjoy the beautiful sunshine and mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 4℃。湿冷感重，添衣保暖很关键。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels like 4℃. It's damp and cold, so layering up is key.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 3℃，有点凉。记得多穿件外套哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feels like 3℃, a bit chilly. Remember to wear a jacket!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，体感 12℃。注意防潮防湿！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, 100% humidity, feels like 12℃. Pay attention to moisture protection!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 8℃，微凉。早晚温差大，别着凉！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels like 8℃, slightly cool. Mind the temperature difference!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 2℃。湿冷感重，注意防寒保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 2℃. It's damp and cold, keep warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 12℃，湿度大。注意防潮，多穿衣！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 12℃ with high humidity. Mind moisture, dress warmly!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴，体感 -15℃！出门全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feels like -15℃! Bundle up completely to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 -7℃。天气寒冷，记得多穿厚衣服！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -7℃. It's cold, remember to wear thick clothes!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 15℃。早晚温差大，带件薄外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Big temperature difference, bring a light jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 7℃，有风。外出记得多加衣物！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 7℃ with wind. Remember to wear more clothes outside!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴天，体感 -1℃。风力不小，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like -1℃. It's windy, so dress warm and block the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感 -4℃。风大天冷，出门注意防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -4℃. It's windy and cold, so mind the wind!
